verdict.rationale: Cactus markets an 'Automation Foundation Model' (Needle) that completes tool-calling loops via run() and can stream live audio into tool calls in one engine call. That makes it a building block a developer could use to construct on-device automations. There is no evidence of a user-facing way to set up automations that run autonomously in the background. Community testing also shows frequent misfired tool calls and unreliable confidence scores, which limits safe unattended use. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation setup, scheduling/triggers or background execution, persistent autonomous runs, and evidence of reliable unattended operation.
